head: SANS
nzh: 底色加两三团柔和光斑，别用紫蓝渐变；只有浮层、卡片、标签栏用毛玻璃；毛玻璃是半透明白加模糊和 1px 白描边；正文区用实色，玻璃上的字照样要够深
nen: Two or three soft light blobs on the background, not a purple-blue gradient; frosted glass only on overlays, cards and tab bars; glass = translucent white, blur and a 1px white border; solid elsewhere, text on glass stays dark
bgImage: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 15%, #FFD9C7 0, transparent 45%), radial-gradient(circle at 85% 70%, #C9E2FF 0, transparent 50%)
